title: Compare a missed chance
guide: Press Compare in the explanation, then close it and follow the green Better was line.

title: Try your own move
guide: Press ◀ once to return before Bxd1. With “Explain moves I try” checked, drag the knight from b8 to c6. The app will analyze your move.

title: Follow an annotated mistake
guide: The pawn on b5 is marked on the board. Click Bxb5 in “After your move, best play” to see the capture, then follow the green Better was line.
